title: 第4章 警务通？-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    手机桌面上多了一个图标。

    图标是深蓝色盾牌底，上面三个白字：警务通。

    他愣了一秒。

    警务通？

    这玩意儿他太熟了。不是说他用过，而是之前在网上见过很多次。

    派出所民警办案、查身份、录信息，基本都靠这个。

    甚至有些博主做普法视频的时候，还专门拿警务通的界面演示过。

    属于那种——普通人没权限用，但大家都知道长什么样的东西。

    现在它出现在了自己手机上。

    顾承安点开。

    弹出登录界面，和他在网上见过的几乎一模一样。

    输入系统提供的账号和密码。

    他按下登录。

    界面加载了不到两秒，标准的警务通主页就弹了出来。

    顶部横幅是“公安部警务综合平台”，下方排列着密密麻麻的功能入口——人口信息查询、在逃人员比对、车辆轨迹查询、案件管理、电子笔录、治安管控……

    点开个人主页：

    姓名：顾承安

    年龄：24

    职位：公安部特派督察员。

    警衔：三级警司。

    警号：NB9527。

    看到这里，顾承安愣了一秒。懂了。

    这是一个掩护身份。

    接着一个一个往下翻。

    功能模块很齐全，跟他之前在网上看到的版本相比，界面更新了不少，分类也更细。但核心逻辑没变，就是一个移动端的综合办案工具。

    当然不是每个ID都拥有查看这些的权限。

    他随手点进“人口信息查询”，输入了自己的名字和身份证号。

    秒出结果。

    姓名、性别、民族、户籍地址、照片，全部准确无误。

    甚至连他三年前在学校补办身份证时拍的那张照片都有——当时刚熬了通宵，眼袋能装二两水，丑得他现在都不忍直视。

    行，是真的。

    顾承安退出来，继续往下滑。

    常规的功能区到这里基本就结束了。再往下是一些通知公告、学习培训模块，没什么看头。

    他的手指滑到页面最底部，停住了。

    底部有一个不起眼的分页指示器——两个小圆点，第一个高亮，第二个灰色。

    还有第二页。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There is an additional icon on the mobile phone desktop.

The icon is a dark blue shield with three white words on it: Police Pass.

He was stunned for a second.

Police pass?

He is very familiar with this stuff.It’s not that he has used it before, but he has seen it many times online before.

Police officers at the police station basically rely on this to handle cases, check identities, and record information.

Some bloggers even demonstrated the interface of Police Pass when making videos to popularize the law.

It’s the kind of thing that ordinary people don’t have permission to use, but everyone knows what it looks like.

Now it appears on my phone.

Gu Chengan clicked on it.

The login interface popped up, almost exactly the same as what he had seen online.

Enter the account number and password provided by the system.

He pressed log in.

It took less than two seconds for the interface to load, and the standard Police Pass home page popped up.

The top banner is the "Ministry of Public Security Police Comprehensive Platform", and underneath are densely packed functional entrances - population information inquiry, fugitive comparison, vehicle trajectory inquiry, case management, electronic transcripts, public security control...

Click to open your personal homepage:

Name: Gu Chengan

Age: 24

Position: Special Inspector of the Ministry of Public Security.

Police rank: Superintendent Third Class.

Police number: NB9527.

Seeing this, Gu Chengan was stunned for a second.Got it.

This is a cover identity.

Then turn down one by one.

The functional modules are very complete. Compared with the version he saw online before, the interface has been updated a lot and the categories are more detailed.But the core logic has not changed, it is a comprehensive case-handling tool on the mobile side.

Of course not every ID has the permission to view these.

He casually clicked on “Population Information Query” and entered his name and ID number.

Results are available within seconds.

Your name, gender, ethnicity, household registration address, and photos are all accurate.

There is even the photo he took when he applied for a new ID card at school three years ago - he had just stayed up all night and had bags under his eyes that could hold two taels of water. He was so ugly that he couldn't bear to look at it now.

Okay, it’s true.

Gu Chengan exited and continued to slide down.

The regular functional area basically ends here.Further down are some announcements and learning and training modules, which are nothing interesting.

His finger slid to the bottom of the page and stopped.

There is an inconspicuous paging indicator at the bottom - two small dots, the first highlighted and the second gray.

There is also a second page.
Page (1/3)
